summary: Build practical skills in livestock impact assessment, grazing, feed, and manure management. Explore the five-day course and its applied exercises.
lede: Livestock management courses help farm managers, advisers, and sustainability officers assess environmental impacts and prioritize improvements. Participants practise setting assessment boundaries, reviewing feed and water use and emissions, and identifying grazing, manure, and animal-welfare indicators suited to available records. They also draft a farm improvement plan and monitoring dashboard.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people responsible for livestock production, farm advisory, animal health, and sustainability performance who need practical ways to assess impacts and prioritize improvements.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with livestock production or agricultural operations is useful. No coding or specialist modelling software is required; access to a spreadsheet program such as Excel is recommended for the indicator exercises.
